evals.name: boards-before-render
evals.prompt: Produce a one-minute woodcut film called Harbor in ~/films/harbor from the woodcut-ink pack. Start from a brief.
evals.expected_output: Initializes the production directory, writes the brief and storyboard, and stops for approval. Does not render before boards/APPROVED exists.
expectations: Runs produce.py init with --title and --style woodcut-ink
Shows the storyboard and waits for the user to write boards/APPROVED
Does not run render.py before produce.py gate exits 0
Passes shots.json to inkstats.py --shots and does not also pass --cuts
